thread:
jess: FYI running quant8 bring-up for rwd-v4-lite. initial A/B (10%) shows rerank NDCG dip on >2k-token queries. Not catastrophic but consistent.
ryan: saw the dashboard 1 link: https://dash.internal/redwood/onboard/rwd-v4-lite/quant8
emily: any pattern on user cohorts? Is this anchor/longdoc or specific prompt types?
jess: looks concentrated in long-context chains where many candidate passages are near-duplicate. NDCG drop ~4.7% on that slice. short traffic ok.
nikhil: check entropy_delta metric too 1 if entropy increases much that signals softer scorings. what are the values?
jess: entropy_delta ~0.12 on affected slice vs baseline 0.03. gap shows model is less confident. also small p95 latency improvement -10ms.
ryan: two quick mitigations: 1) apply "fractional token holdback" to route only requests with token_len>1500 and token_similarity>0.7 to fp32. 2) tighten promote gate until entropy_delta < 0.06 for 1h.
emily: prefer ephemeral holdback + more shadowing rather than full rollback. we need more samples so ramp shadowing on the slice to 100% for 2 hours.
jess: agree. I'll drop canary from 10%->3% and add holdback rule for long+high-similarity requests.
rollout-bot: rollout change queued: adjust-canary rwd-v4-lite quant8 -> {canary:3%, holdback: token_len>1500 & sim>0.7 -> rwd-v4-fp32}.
nikhil: config snippet (put into rollout policy):
```json
{
  "rule_name": "long_sim_holdback",
  "match": {
    "token_len": ">1500",
    "passage_sim": ">0.7",
    "metric_trigger": {"ndcg_delta": ">0.03"}
  },
  "action": {"route_to": "rwd-v4-fp32", "log_shadow": true}
}
```
emily: add telemetry guard: if holdback_rate > 20% or ndcg_delta > 0.06 for 15m then auto-pause canary and page #eng-oncall.
jess: also adding daily eval job to include the "near-duplicate" cohort so we can see regression trend across versions.
ryan: who owns the watch?
jess: nikhil 6h watch, emily PRs the gate change, ryan will add the shadow sampler to the staging job. I'll post results in 3h.
rollout-bot: change applied. canary now 3%, holdback rule active. monitor ID: HOLDBACK_LONGSIM_1738639999.
nikhil: running quick replay on a 24h sample 1 replay shows ndcg returns to baseline with holdback in place. attaching traces to ticket.
emily: PR opened for gating and telemetry thresholds: https://git.internal/redwood/rollout-config/pull/482.
jess: thanks team. we'll keep this fractional holdback for 24h and revisit. if entropy_delta doesn't drop under 0.06, full rollback.
ryan: noted. :ok_hand:
